description: This Java source file defines the class HookCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer, which is responsible for deserializing and validating JSON input related to hook commands in the Fineract project. It primarily contains methods to validate JSON data for creating and updating hooks, focusing on supported parameters and basic data validation.

classes.name: HookCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A component responsible for deserializing and validating JSON input for hook commands, such as creating or updating hooks within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating a hook, ensuring required fields like 'name' are present and conform to constraints, and that 'templateId' is valid if provided.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating a hook, checking optional parameters like 'name' and 'templateId' for correctness.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if any validation errors are recorded during validation processes.
